summary: Dataflow Managed I/O can automatically use the latest reliable version of supported I/O connectors.
extended_definition: Dataflow Managed I/O can automatically use the latest reliable version of supported I/O connectors.

supporting_pages.title: Dataflow managed I/O \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Automatic upgrades Dataflow pipelines with managed I/O connectors automatically use the latest reliable version of the connector.
Dataflow automatically upgrades the managed I/O connectors in your pipeline.
For streaming jobs, Dataflow upgrades your Managed I/O connectors in running pipelines as new versions become available.

supporting_pages.title: Troubleshoot Dataflow errors \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Pipelines that use Managed I/O might fail with this error if Dataflow can't automatically upgrade the I/O transforms to the latest supported version.
Dataflow automatically retries sending the Pub/Sub messages with a backoff delay.
Dataflow automatically responds to and addresses the underlying issue.
